function.name: ActorType13_PlayerCollisionHandler
behavior: Clears the source actor's owned resources and initializes a backward-slot response actor when a slot is available.
Copies the source actor position to the response actor and subtracts 0x20 from its vertical position.
Sets the response actor field at offset +0x09 to 0xFF and arms the response timer at 0x00FFF124 to 8.
Queues the response audio command when SCENE_TRANSITION_EVENT is set.

conclusion: The type-0x13 branch is a dedicated player-collision response handler that materializes a vertically offset response actor; it is not a direct player-coordinate or scene-state transfer writer.
